incidents.name: Futureswap fee unit confused for basis points
incidents.notes: The exchange computed a token-denominated fee (abs(delta) * feeRateWad / 1e18) and forwarded it to FeeManager.addFee(), which interpreted the value as a basis-point weight, so an oversized trade produced an absurd fee share that redeemed the pool's USDC.e and WETH inventory.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim proxy created 2021-10-13 by 0x5ed35ea85fad2f578685a4d8e404c12164ea516c (not the attacker); three EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2021-12-18 to implementation 0x010659727ad7716c239e206acd3ebee0fdc9e207, so the exploited code was ~4 years old. Attack-tx logs show 894,992.85 USDC.e and 68 WETH leaving the proxy against 496,500 USDC.e paid in. DefiLlama records $395,000 (FutureSwap, 2026-01-10, Arbitrum, Withdrawal Logic Flaw).
